freeze_context.note: The mechanism was proposed after exploratory geometry and tail results were inspected. The predictor, negative-control, held-out-prediction, monotonicity, and falsification rules below were frozen before any randomized shared-start branch, spectral-transplant, or new-seed confirmatory outcome existed.

amendments.reason: Correct the forward bridge to use only anchors with two already-audited adjacent discovery BEIR checkpoints. The pretrained anchor has no local full-BEIR baseline and final checkpoints have no successor; neither may be assigned a synthetic outcome. No predictor, outcome, threshold, or observed result changed.

Make the already-declared entropy effective-rank metric algebraically exact and consistent with the frozen common-state spectrum analysis: Shannon probabilities are normalized singular values, while head/middle/tail energy continues to use squared singular values.

Correct the forward-retrieval cross-validation prose from three transitions per held-out run to the two frozen eligible transitions (stage1-to-stage2 and stage3-to-stage4). Expected rows, predictors, outcomes, thresholds, and analysis code are unchanged.

predictor_extraction.displacement: stage1 minus shared start; every later stage minus the immediately preceding branch checkpoint

band_boundaries.rounding: nearest integer boundaries with complete disjoint coverage

per_tensor_metrics.update_stable_rank_fraction: stable rank divided by min(rows, columns)
per_tensor_metrics.update_entropy_rank_fraction: exp(-sum_i p_i log p_i) divided by min(rows, columns), with p_i = singular_value_i / sum_j singular_value_j
per_tensor_metrics.update_head_energy_fraction: fraction of squared singular values in the head band
per_tensor_metrics.update_middle_energy_fraction: fraction of squared singular values in the middle band
per_tensor_metrics.update_tail_energy_fraction: fraction of squared singular values in the tail band
per_tensor_metrics.update_row_norm_cv: population standard deviation divided by mean row norm

predictor_extraction.tensor_aggregation: trainable-parameter-count-weighted arithmetic mean over all selected hidden matrices

global_negative_controls.update_frobenius_norm: root sum square of the selected hidden-matrix displacement norms
global_negative_controls.weight_frobenius_norm: root sum square of the current selected hidden-matrix weight norms

analysis.early_aggregation: arithmetic mean within seed and operator
analysis.prediction: leave-one-seed-out ordinary least squares on paired contrasts, with every held-out seed contributing both challenger contrasts
analysis.label_only_baseline: challenger-specific mean outcome contrast in the two training seeds
analysis.mediator_model: intercept plus challenger indicator plus training-fold-standardized single predictor
analysis.coefficient_shrinkage: descriptive absolute optimizer-indicator coefficient reduction after adding one standardized predictor to the nine randomized units

primary_support_rule.treatment_shift: the primary predictor contrast is positive for both challengers in at least two of three seeds
primary_support_rule.outcome_shift: both final outcomes favor each challenger in at least two of three seeds
primary_support_rule.held_out_prediction: the primary predictor improves pooled LOSO RMSE over the label-only baseline for both outcomes
primary_support_rule.negative_control: neither frozen norm control equals or exceeds the primary predictor's LOSO RMSE improvement on either outcome
primary_support_rule.coefficient_behavior: the primary predictor does not increase the absolute Muon or NorMuon treatment coefficient for either outcome
primary_support_rule.decision: all conditions are required; otherwise the spectral temporal bridge is not supported

analysis.reporting_rule: Report every predictor and negative control regardless of sign; secondary predictors cannot replace a failed primary predictor in the headline claim.

temporal_short_branch.claim_boundary: The shared-start randomization identifies optimizer-level accumulated effects. The post-treatment spectral predictor analysis is a small-sample, falsifiable causal-chain triangulation, not a formally identified causal mediation estimate.

anchor_scope.selection: all ten frozen DenseOn common-state anchors

dose_response.anchor_monotonicity: all four adjacent lambda differences satisfy the declared weak monotone direction with no outcome-dependent tolerance
dose_response.support_threshold: at least 8 of 10 anchors are monotone for each primary metric

band_localization.support_rule: the tail transplant has the most favorable primary loss and margin contrast among the three bands in at least 8 of 10 anchors

basis_negative_control.support_rule: the spectrum condition is more favorable than the basis condition for both primary metrics in at least 8 of 10 anchors

eligible_anchor_transitions.stage1: stage1 to stage2 within source run
eligible_anchor_transitions.stage3: stage3 to stage4 within source run
eligible_anchor_transitions.excluded: the pretrained anchor has no local full-BEIR baseline and stage5 anchors have no forward checkpoint; both remain in the ten-anchor local intervention tests but are excluded from forward prediction

forward_retrieval_bridge.retrieval_outcome: same-task next-checkpoint minus anchor-checkpoint decontaminated BEIR nDCG@10
forward_retrieval_bridge.cross_validation: leave one complete source run out, holding out all fourteen tasks and both eligible transitions for that run
forward_retrieval_bridge.baseline_model: ordinary least squares with task and transition categorical effects fitted on the two training runs
forward_retrieval_bridge.predictor_model: the same baseline plus one training-fold-standardized immediate intervention predictor
forward_retrieval_bridge.support_rule: at least one prespecified spectrum predictor improves pooled held-out RMSE over baseline, and its matched basis negative control does not equal or exceed that improvement

dose_band.overall_decision: The spectral-component explanation is supported only if dose response, tail-band localization, basis negative control, and forward retrieval bridge all pass. Failure of the forward bridge limits the conclusion to an immediate fixed-state optimization effect even if all local intervention tests pass.
dose_band.claim_boundary: The transplant randomizes spectral components at fixed weights and can identify immediate functional effects. Its task-aligned forward prediction is out-of-run evidence for a causal-chain bridge, but it is not a trained spectral-operator intervention and cannot by itself identify formal mediation of final BEIR gains.
